_note: PSM (Problem Structure Model) target schema v1 (owner decision 2026-10-03): the GLiNER-native extraction schema the structure tier (GLiNER2.5) is asked for, and the target of a later fine-tune. Labels and descriptions are model-facing schema data, not user-facing text. lib/formalize/structure/ reads this file; the deterministic converter turns the extraction into SOP-IR. No logic is extracted here: the LFM writes the logic. A relation`s render template (model-facing input, data) turns an extracted relation into one statement of the PSM-based sketch given to the LFM.

entities.entity: a person, object, place, group or named thing the problem talks about
entities.event: an action or happening, such as buying, arriving, filling or meeting
entities.state: a property or situation that holds for a thing, such as open, wet, empty or late
entities.quantity: a number together with what it counts or measures, such as 24 muffins, 3 dollars or 15 minutes
entities.condition: a requirement or if-clause that must hold, such as if it rains or only when the door is open
entities.rule: a general statement that holds for every case, such as every bird can fly or each box holds 6 eggs
entities.constraint: a limit or restriction, such as at most 5 people or no two in the same seat
entities.goal: what the question asks to find, decide or compute
entities.assumption: something the problem says to assume or suppose
